title: Truncated section conormal residue kernel as a submodule inclusion
statement: Under the hypotheses of the truncated section conormal residue kernel theorem, the comap of the maximal-ideal submodule along the cotangent complex map is contained in the maximal-ideal submodule of the cotangent module.

proof.text: Put C = P.Ring, J = P.ker, L = m^N and E = C/(J^2 + L). The kernel K of E -> C/(J + L) is the image of J in E: the image of L is zero. Its square is zero since the image of J^2 is zero. These are the fully proved private helpers truncated_factor_ker and truncated_factor_ker_sq.

Construct the C-linear map q: J -> (J/J^2)/n(J/J^2). The quotient map t: J -> K is surjective. If t(j)=0, write j=a+b with a in J^2 and b in L. Since j and a are in J, b is in L intersect J, hence in mJ by hAR. Surjectivity of C -> S makes it a local homomorphism, so m acts through n; consequently q kills mJ, as proved by smul induction. It also kills J^2. Thus ker(t) is contained in ker(q), and liftQ followed by the inverse quotient-kernel isomorphism gives a C-linear map l: K -> (J/J^2)/n(J/J^2), sending every class of j to q(j). This is the fully proved private helper truncated_kernel_to_residue_conormal.

Use Mathlib derivationOfSectionOfKerSqZero, the derivation construction in the proof of the square-zero-section conormal retraction, for the section sigma. Precompose this derivation E -> K with C -> E and postcompose with l. This gives an R-derivation d: C -> (J/J^2)/n(J/J^2). For j in J, sigma takes its zero image in C/(J+L) to zero, so d(j)=q(j). Apply liftKaehlerDifferential and liftBaseChange to obtain an S-linear map v: P.CotangentSpace -> P.Cotangent/n(P.Cotangent).

On classes generated by j in J, cotangentComplex_mk and the defining formulas of liftBaseChange and liftKaehlerDifferential give v(cotangentComplex(mk(j)))=q(j). Since Cotangent.mk is surjective, v composed with cotangentComplex equals the residue quotient projection. S-linearity and smul induction show that v kills n times the cotangent space, since n annihilates its residue-quotient target. Thus any x in the stated comap has zero residue class, and Quotient.mk_eq_zero gives x in n times the cotangent module. The proof uses no differential modulo-power comparison and does not require the lower bound hN; the original signature is retained.

theorem truncated_section_conormal_residue_kernel_comap
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing S] (P : Extension.{u} R S) [IsLocalRing P.Ring]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hAR : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring) ^ N •
        (⊤ : Submodule P.Ring P.Ring) ⊓ P.ker) ≤
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring) • P.ker)
    (σ : (P.Ring ⧸ (P.ker ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring ^ N)) →ₐ[R]
        (P.Ring ⧸ (P.ker ^ 2 ⊔ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P.Ring ^ N)))
    (hσ : (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R
        (sup_le_sup (Ideal.pow_le_self (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)) le_rfl)).comp σ =
      AlgHom.id R _) :
    Submodule.comap P.cotangentComplex
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) • (⊤ : Submodule S P.CotangentSpace)) ≤
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) • (⊤ : Submodule S P.Cotangent)
